applications.title: Application Registry
applications.intro: Register the applications that module profiles can target by executable name. The chips on each card show how every module currently treats that application — click one to jump to its profile, or to create one.
applications.executableHelp: Executable matching is case-insensitive, but the name must include the application extension. For example: DCS.exe
applications.empty: No applications registered yet. Add one before creating module profiles.

chip.defaultOffTitle: The default {module} profile is off. Click to create a custom profile for this application.
chip.customTitle: Custom {module} profile "{profile}" applies. Click to open it.
chip.defaultTitle: The default {module} profile applies. Click to create a custom profile for this application.

discovery.trackingOnTitle: Discovery is tracking the OpenXR apps you launch.
discovery.trackingOffTitle: Discovery is off. New OpenXR app launches will not be recorded until you enable tracking in Settings.
discovery.title: Where new apps come from
discovery.intro: VectorXR notes the OpenXR apps you launch so you can easily register them in one click. Nothing here changes your settings until you register it. Tracking is controlled in Settings.
discovery.allRegistered: Every discovered app is registered. New apps you launch will appear here.
discovery.allRegisteredTrackingOff: Every discovered app is registered. Tracking is off, so no new apps will appear here.
discovery.empty: No XR apps seen yet. Launch an OpenXR app while VectorXR is active, then refresh this list.
discovery.emptyTrackingOff: Application tracking is disabled, so no new apps will appear here. Enable tracking in Settings to record OpenXR app launches.
